mapper.select:
del_flag = '0' AND capa_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{capaNo}, '%') AND source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sourceNo}, '%') AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%') AND capa_status = #{capaStatus}
